decisionLog.decision: set designPersonality="practical, local, immediate"; cap visualExpression="low_to_medium"; append sectionArchitecture=["location","hours","contact","services"]
decisionLog.rationale: A local visitor usually wants one fact — where, when, or how to call — and wants it immediately.

decisionLog.decision: set color.tokenSystem="semantic_tokens_derived_from_one_seed"; forbid color="raw_hex_in_components"; require color="every component consumes a semantic token, never a primitive or a literal"
decisionLog.rationale: A colour defined per component survives neither a brand change nor a theme change; tokens are what make either possible.

decisionLog.decision: set color.contrastFloor="wcag_2_2_aa"; require a11y="4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text and UI boundaries, in every state"
decisionLog.rationale: Contrast is a measurement, not an impression, and it must hold in every interactive state rather than only at rest.
decisionLog.fallback: darken or lighten the surface, never the brand mark

decisionLog.rationale: Unbounded viewport-relative type is unreadable at both extremes; a clamped scale keeps measure and hierarchy intact.

decisionLog.decision: forbid interaction="hover-only-product-info"; require interaction="every hover affordance has a focus and tap equivalent"
decisionLog.rationale: Hover does not exist on touch and is not reachable by keyboard, so information behind it is information withheld.

decisionLog.decision: require motion="prefers-reduced-motion alternative that conveys the same information"
decisionLog.rationale: A reduced-motion user must receive the same information, not a degraded summary of it.

decisionLog.decision: forbid immersive="webgl_only_proposition"; require immersive="semantic HTML states the proposition independently"
decisionLog.rationale: Canvas content is invisible to assistive technology and to crawlers, so a proposition living only there is unreadable to both.
decisionLog.fallback: static image or video poster with semantic copy

decisionLog.decision: set responsive.strategy="container_first"; require responsive="viewport queries for page layout, container queries for components"
decisionLog.rationale: A component's available space is its container, not the window; keying it to the viewport breaks it the first time it is reused elsewhere.

decisionLog.decision: require responsive="no core content or task lost at 320 CSS px or 400% zoom"; forbid responsive="hiding essential content to simplify a narrow layout"
decisionLog.rationale: Reflow is a WCAG requirement and the narrowest real viewport is 320; content removed there is removed for the people most constrained.

decisionLog.decision: require responsive="coarse pointer receives a visible, tappable equivalent"; require responsive="interactive targets at least 24 CSS px, 44 preferred on mobile"
decisionLog.rationale: Input capability, not screen width, decides whether hover exists; a large tablet is still a touch device.

decisionLog.decision: require performance="route JS within the archetype budget after enhancement"; require performance="heavy modules dynamically imported"
decisionLog.rationale: A budget that is only reported is a budget that is exceeded; exceeding it must change the plan automatically.
decisionLog.fallback: downgrade the largest enhancement to its declared fallback

decisionLog.decision: require performance="width/height or aspect-ratio on every image and embed"; require performance="responsive source selection via sizes/srcset"
decisionLog.rationale: Unsized media is the most common cause of layout shift, and CLS is a release gate.
Content that appears only after hydration is content a crawler may never see, and enhancement must never remove it from the semantic document.
decisionLog.fallback: static generation of every public route

decisionLog.decision: require seo="emit a schema type only when its backing evidence is verified"; forbid seo="fabricated_schema"
decisionLog.rationale: Marking up a rating or product the business cannot evidence is a fabricated claim wearing an SEO label, and §12 forbids it outright.

decisionLog.decision: require content="hide the unverified claim and request the evidence"; forbid content="generated_substitute_for_proof"
decisionLog.rationale: A missing proof asset is a content problem; solving it by generating proof converts it into a false statement about the business.
decisionLog.fallback: neutral non-factual structure in the same slot

decisionLog.decision: forbid imagery="simulated_people_places_products_or_outcomes"; require imagery="weak assets take the typography/CSS/SVG route, never poor photography"
decisionLog.rationale: Weak imagery behind elaborate effects reads as a business with nothing to show; typography and diagrams state the same thing honestly.

decisionLog.decision: require quality="all hard gates pass before production, regardless of score"
decisionLog.rationale: Compilation proves the code runs, not that the website works for a person; the gates are what test the latter.
decisionLog.fallback: block release and report the failing gate

decisionLog.decision: forbid interaction="auto-rotating-carousel"; require interaction="user-controlled advancement with visible controls"
decisionLog.rationale: Users need control and should not miss primary content.
Maps are high-cost interactive embeds and should solve a geographic task.
Line length affects readability and scanning.
Large type can create immediate hierarchy but cannot repair vague copy.
decisionLog.fallback: moderate heading scale with stronger hierarchy

decisionLog.rationale: Responsive layouts need controlled content width, especially on large displays.
Grid should follow item minimum usable width, not device labels.
Bento supports modular scanning, not all information types.
decisionLog.fallback: equal feature grid or sequential sections

decisionLog.rationale: Asymmetry directs attention and signals character, but can harm scanning when overused.
Immersive media is useful when it contributes actual evidence or atmosphere.
Split layouts pair proposition with proof when both are meaningful.

decisionLog.decision: require hero="answers what, for whom, why it matters, next step"; set hero.mustAnswer=["what","for_whom","why_it_matters","next_step"]
decisionLog.rationale: Visitors need immediate relevance and action clarity.

decisionLog.decision: set nav.structure="explicit_hierarchy_plus_search_or_local_nav"; require nav="descriptive labels and a current-location state"
decisionLog.rationale: Navigation should expose information scent for major user tasks.

decisionLog.decision: set nav.compactMode="accessible_drawer_or_compact_bar"; require nav="keyboard controls, visible close, route parity with the full navigation"; forbid nav="hover_only_mega_menu"
decisionLog.rationale: Mobile navigation requires explicit touch and keyboard interaction.
Specific CTA labels reduce uncertainty about the next outcome.
decisionLog.fallback: "Contact us" only when no more specific approved action exists

decisionLog.rationale: Multiple equal CTAs dilute hierarchy.
decisionLog.fallback: move secondary action to a text link

decisionLog.rationale: Persistent action can reduce friction when the action is clearly valuable and non-obstructive.

decisionLog.decision: set components.repeatedItems="card_system"; require components="each card has a clear subject and either a meaningful action or an explicitly non-interactive state"
decisionLog.rationale: Cards should represent a single subject and communicate their interactive state.
Progressive disclosure reduces initial density but should not conceal key decision information.

decisionLog.decision: forbid components="tabs_hiding_a_pages_main_content"; require components="tabs, if ever used, carry accessible tab roles and keyboard behaviour"
decisionLog.rationale: Tabs work for closely related views, not long concealed content.

decisionLog.decision: set components.carousel="secondary_content_only"; forbid interaction="auto-rotating-carousel"; require components="any carousel has manual controls, keyboard access, touch access and a visible position indicator"
decisionLog.rationale: Auto-rotating carousels create missed content and poor control.
Direct visual comparison can demonstrate change when evidence is genuine.

decisionLog.decision: set interaction.stateFeedback="required"; require interaction="visible focus, pressed, selected, loading, success and error states with no decorative delay"
decisionLog.rationale: Interaction feedback communicates action availability and outcome.

decisionLog.decision: require motion="every animation serves one of: state feedback, spatial relationship, sequence explanation, attention guidance"; forbid motion="animation_without_stated_purpose"
decisionLog.rationale: Motion should communicate relationships, availability, or outcomes.

decisionLog.decision: forbid interaction="horizontal_primary_page_navigation"; forbid interaction="scroll_hijacking"; require interaction="any horizontal section has manual controls, keyboard access and a vertical mobile fallback"
decisionLog.rationale: Two-dimensional movement should be reserved for content where spatial relationship is meaningful.

decisionLog.decision: set selection.maxElements=5; set selection.minElements=2; set selection.maxSignatureExperiences=1
decisionLog.rationale: Visual coherence and performance improve when each page has a controlled grammar.

decisionLog.decision: require responsive="every component evaluated against viewport, container width, pointer, hover, reduced motion, text zoom, orientation and safe area"; forbid responsive="device_name_only_logic"
decisionLog.rationale: Responsive design adapts to space and capabilities, not a simple desktop/tablet/mobile taxonomy.
Card columns should respond to usable card width.
Non-rectangular and mobile browser viewports can obscure fixed UI.
Mobile browser chrome changes visible viewport height.

decisionLog.decision: require responsive="core task preserved in both portrait and landscape"; forbid responsive="orientation_lock"
decisionLog.rationale: Users may operate content in different orientations; restriction needs a genuine exception.
decisionLog.fallback: layout that maintains core task in both orientations

decisionLog.rationale: Large screens provide space but do not justify unbounded readable content.

decisionLog.decision: require responsive="critical content kept out of the hinge on multi-segment viewports"; forbid responsive="form_or_cta_split_across_hinge"
decisionLog.rationale: Foldable layouts should adapt without placing core UI in unusable hinge regions.

decisionLog.decision: require images="width/height or aspect-ratio on every responsive image"; require images="srcset/sizes or the framework equivalent"; forbid images="sending_desktop_originals_to_all_devices"
decisionLog.rationale: Dimensions prevent CLS and source selection controls transfer size.

decisionLog.decision: require images="next/image with `sizes` whenever fill or responsive CSS width is used, and a reserved aspect ratio or positioned parent"; forbid images="fill_without_sizes"
decisionLog.rationale: sizes informs browser source selection and prevents over-downloading.
Semantic HTML supplies baseline keyboard and assistive technology behavior.

decisionLog.decision: require a11y="every interactive element keyboard operable, with visible focus and a logical focus order"; forbid a11y="pointer_only_controls"
decisionLog.rationale: Core interaction cannot depend on pointer or gesture.

decisionLog.decision: set a11y.stickyChrome="scroll_padding_and_scroll_margin"; require a11y="focus never entirely hidden by sticky, fixed or overlay UI"
decisionLog.rationale: WCAG 2.2 requires focus not be entirely obscured by author-created content.

decisionLog.decision: require motion="auto-starting motion lasting over 5 seconds has a pause/stop/hide mechanism"; require motion="non-essential interaction-triggered motion has a reduced-motion alternative"
decisionLog.rationale: Users must be able to control disruptive or non-essential motion.
Images require alternatives when they convey information; decoration should not create screen-reader noise.

decisionLog.decision: set forms.policy="visible_and_programmatic_labels_errors_recovery_success"; set forms.validation="server_plus_client_assistance"; forbid forms="placeholder_only_labels"; forbid forms="silent_failure"
decisionLog.rationale: Forms require explicit labels and understandable feedback.
LCP is driven by the largest visible content and must load quickly.
decisionLog.fallback: static optimized image or text-first hero

decisionLog.rationale: Less initial client JavaScript improves loading and interaction responsiveness.

decisionLog.decision: set performance.heavyModuleLoading="dynamic_import_on_viewport_or_intent"; require performance="WebGL, maps, Lottie, video, large galleries and story choreography load on intent or near-viewport, never on the initial route"
decisionLog.rationale: Heavy modules should not delay the initial route without demonstrated value.
Transform and opacity usually avoid costly layout/paint work.

decisionLog.decision: set performance.embedLoading="deferred_until_intent_or_near_viewport"; require performance="every third-party embed reserves its layout space and offers a click-to-load preview"; forbid performance="embed_in_initial_viewport_without_need"
decisionLog.rationale: Third-party embeds can add performance and layout-shift cost.

decisionLog.decision: set seo.metadataPolicy="page_specific_title_description_canonical_og"; require seo="every indexable page carries a page-specific title, description, canonical when needed, and Open Graph metadata"; forbid seo="duplicate_generic_metadata"
decisionLog.rationale: Accurate metadata supports search and shareability.
decisionLog.fallback: derived metadata from verified page content

decisionLog.decision: set seo.contentHubs="service_pages_for_offers_with_supplied_content"; append sectionArchitecture=["faq","internal_links"]; require seo="each derived page targets a distinct search intent; no thin near-duplicate pages"
decisionLog.rationale: Search strategy requires useful, differentiated page intent.
decisionLog.fallback: smaller set of deeper verified pages

decisionLog.decision: require images="descriptive alt or caption for every meaningful image; optimised file name, dimensions and format"; forbid images="text_embedded_solely_in_image"
decisionLog.rationale: Images should have accessible and contextual semantics.

decisionLog.decision: set identity.mark="verified_name_wordmark"; set identity.markStatus="provisional"; forbid identity="invented_trademark_like_logo"
decisionLog.rationale: Identity can be presented safely without claiming an unapproved logo.

decisionLog.decision: require content="customer logo wall hidden unless every logo is verified with a real relationship and permission"; forbid content="recognisable_brand_logos_without_relationship_and_permission"
decisionLog.rationale: Client logos imply a factual commercial relationship.

decisionLog.decision: require content="each proof module hidden unless verified; request source, date, permission and scope"; forbid content="invented_badges_ratings_metrics_or_claims"
decisionLog.rationale: Reputational and regulated proof requires source-backed verification.
decisionLog.fallback: no proof module, or verified methodology text

decisionLog.decision: set contact.publicCta="blocked_until_verified"; require content="request a verified contact method before any public contact CTA"; forbid content="guessed_email_phone_social_or_address"
decisionLog.rationale: A CTA must have a real, verified endpoint.
decisionLog.fallback: hide contact section until a functional route exists

decisionLog.decision: require content="pricing cards hidden unless pricing is verified; an approved enquiry CTA is the only substitute"; forbid content="invented_starting_price_discount_plan_trial_or_guarantee"
decisionLog.rationale: Pricing is commercial factual content and requires approval.
decisionLog.fallback: "Discuss requirements" only if the route is verified

decisionLog.rationale: Products must be inspectable and accurately represented before sale.
decisionLog.fallback: hide product gallery and public purchase path

decisionLog.decision: require content="portfolio module hidden unless verified; replaced by a verified capability or process section"; forbid content="invented_projects_clients_outcomes_or_screenshots"
decisionLog.rationale: Portfolio evidence is factual work proof.

decisionLog.decision: set content.aiDraftPolicy="publish_only_after_explicit_approval"; require content="AI-drafted text labelled \"AI draft — verify\" and held until approved"; forbid content="new_metrics_superlatives_outcomes_credentials_or_location_claims_in_drafts"
decisionLog.rationale: AI-generated language may alter a business claim and needs provenance/approval.
Loading state and absent content are different states.
decisionLog.fallback: neutral public layout or hidden section

decisionLog.decision: set quality.thresholds={"production_ready":75,"professionally_designed":82,"world_class":90}; set quality.coreMinimum=6; set quality.worldClassMinimum=7; require quality="world_class additionally requires an approved human design review"
decisionLog.rationale: Quality needs both aggregate score and critical minimums.

decisionLog.decision: set quality.accessibilityGate="blocks_production_regardless_of_score"; require quality="a blocking WCAG failure blocks production regardless of aesthetic or award-style score"
decisionLog.rationale: Accessibility is not a tradeable visual preference.

decisionLog.decision: set quality.contentGate="blocks_production_on_fabricated_or_unverified_public_claim"; require quality="a fabricated or unverified public claim blocks production until removed or verified"
decisionLog.rationale: Production quality requires factual integrity.

decisionLog.decision: set quality.performanceGate="remove_or_defer_nonessential_enhancement_on_vitals_failure"; require quality="a Core Web Vitals failure caused by a non-essential enhancement removes or defers that enhancement"
decisionLog.rationale: Decorative effects cannot justify a failed core experience.
World-class requires owned, context-relevant distinction rather than more effects.
